description: 15-s lock for the manual full refresh (Android RefreshDebounce.kt + RefreshStats.lastFullRefresh / iOS RefreshDebounce.swift + SharedStorage.lastFullRefreshAt). The lock reads only the end of the last FULL refresh (fullAgo, ms before now; null = none yet). Live ticks only move the display time of the widget header (liveAgo = lastRefreshAt, ms before now; null = none) and never block the manual refresh. expected: decide(running, lastFinishedAt = full, now); remainingSeconds: countdown in the menu (rounded up, 0 = free).

cases.name: live tick 5 s ago, last full refresh 10 min ago: start
live tick just now, no full refresh yet: start
full refresh 8 s ago (no live): recent
full refresh 8 s ago, live tick 1 s ago: still recent from the full refresh
full refresh exactly 15 s ago: start
full refresh 14.2 s ago: 1 s left
full refresh in the future (clock set back): start
